correctness.rationale: For D constant on each block, ||DM||∞=max_q d_q alpha_q and ||(DM)^-1||∞=max_l sum_q C_lq/d_q. For any positive scales, set T=max d_q alpha_q, giving objective >=max_l sum_q alpha_q C_lq; equality at d_q=1/alpha_q proves K*. For dyadic d_q=2^{k_q}, normalize a maximizing block s to k_s=0. Replacing each other k_q by floor(log2(alpha_s/alpha_q)) cannot increase maximum forward norm and lowers inverse sum, hence one of exactly b candidates attains global unbounded-integer minimum. Largest circular gap of b fractional log2 alpha_q phases has length >=1/b, so integer shifts make all scaled log norms lie within width <=1-1/b; this yields K2/K*<=2^{1-1/b}. Diagonal block coefficients 2^{(q-1)/b} have equally spaced phases, forcing the opposite bound; works for arbitrary positive block sizes and b=1. Independent exact rational inversion/condition calculations on 56 small nonsingular examples agreed with complete bounded normalized exponent searches; finite checks corroborate, not prove, arbitrary n.
